decisions.reason: Close to the established offer, keeping costs little and the option remains valuable while uncertainty persists.
The pegboard back variant is an incremental option with low carrying cost, so keeping it preserves flexibility.
A standard quarter-pallet display close to the core line has low keeping costs and no sign of failed value.
The eighth-pallet size is a smaller incremental option, but still close to existing products and cheap to maintain.
Although wooden pallets are less close to the core cardboard line, the option still has potential and has not clearly failed.
A media-product quarter-pallet display is close to established offers and preserves an option for a niche segment.
